versions.changelog:
- Expanded skill description to highlight supported models, app types, and key use-cases.
- Added a detailed installation section explaining the CLI installer process and manual install steps.
- Included new quick command examples for image, video, LLM, web search, Twitter, and 3D model generation.
- Provided comprehensive command reference tables for discovering and running 150+ apps.
- Listed popular available apps and categories, as well as related skills for easy extension.
- Linked to updated documentation and reference materials for seamless onboarding.

Initial release of agent-tools.

- Run 150+ AI apps via inference.sh CLI (image, video, LLMs, search, 3D, Twitter automation, and more)
- Includes commands for listing, searching, filtering, and running cloud AI apps—no GPU required
- Supports popular models: FLUX, Veo, Gemini, Claude, Grok, Tavily, OpenRouter, and others
- Provides easy command examples and category overviews for different AI tasks
- Links to detailed docs and related skills for extending functionality
